name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns Türkiye for removing elected mayors and replacing them with appointed officials, and for arresting some mayors on terrorism claims it calls vague. It asks Türkiye to release and reinstate the mayors, scrap the appointment system, and follow European court rulings. It also asks the European Union to watch the situation closely and consider sanctions on Turkish officials involved.

- The text is an opinion, not a law; no rule changes yet.
- It targets Türkiye's government and the dismissed mayors, mostly in Kurdish areas.
- Next: the EU may monitor and consider sanctions on officials.
